scientific_integrity: The integer homotopy statements are supported by complete finite face enumeration, acyclic matchings and exact integer Morse incidence matrices, not by mod-two Betti numbers alone. Bibliographic uniqueness is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only n=4,5,6,7 in the rank-three Johnson sequence; no conclusion for n>=8, other ranks, or equivariance; no independent audit. Finite exact integer certificates establish the two Moore-space summands.
title: Integral two-torsion and Moore-space summands in the first tetrahedral Johnson neighborhood complexes
